name: Elote Loaded Kettle Chips
desc: Jalapeño kettle chips piled with charred corn, mayo, cotija, crema, chile and lime like a plate of street corn.

source.title: Elote Loaded Kettle Chips
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 cups corn kernels (frozen and thawed, or canned and drained)
ingredients.note: frozen and thawed, or canned and drained

ingredients.raw: 1 tsp Everything But The Elote seasoning

steps: Heat a dry cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat. Add the corn and cook, stirring only every minute or so, until spotty brown, 4 to 5 min. Let it cool for a few minutes.
Spread the chips on a large platter. Spoon the corn over them.
Drizzle the mayonnaise over the corn (a zip-top bag with a corner snipped off works well), then scatter the cotija and sprinkle the Everything But The Elote seasoning and chile de árbol over the top.
Drizzle with the crema, scatter the cilantro, squeeze a lime wedge or two over everything and serve right away with the rest of the lime, before the chips soften.
tips: Everything But The Elote is a Trader Joe's seasoning blend.

references.title: Sheet Pan Street Corn Nachos (Esquites Nachos)
references.usedFor: corn-to-chip ratio, skillet-charring the corn, cotija, crema and cilantro amounts
